items.title: Playanext
items.description: Technical operations for Playanext, a global software distribution company. The platform places complementary software offers in install flows and inside live products so publishers can acquire users and earn incremental revenue. I also built Playa Yield, the company's Chrome extension monetization platform.

items.title: Playa Yield
items.description: Chrome extension monetization platform I created at Playanext. Developers drop in a Manifest V3-compliant SDK and earn from policy-safe ads in popups, side panels, and internal pages—no search injection, no extra permissions. High-volume impressions and real revenue for extension developers.

items.title: OnSport AI
items.description: Injury tracking and prevention software for NBA teams, professional golf, soccer, and international basketball. The system captures player movement from television feeds, reads patterns in the motion, scores injury risk, and presents the analysis in a clear, decision-ready interface for performance staff.
